channel.description: Latest articles from Startup Magazine South Africa (startupmag.co.za)

item.title: Paragon Produce and the Art of Reinvention in Modern Farming
item.description: Discover how Paragon Produce founder Kgotlelelo Mahlake rebuilt his farming business through strategic reinvention and smart expansion. A practical, inspiring story for South African entrepreneurs.

item.title: MITAA Chappa and the Power of Culture Driven Activewear
item.description: Discover how MITAA Chappa founder Zintle Thathi built a culture driven activewear brand rooted in authenticity, identity and strategic growth. An inspiring guide for South African entrepreneurs.

item.title: Crafting an Independent Fragrance Identity: The Rise of Classique Scent RSA
item.description: Discover how Classique Scent RSA grew from a bold career leap to a thriving South African fragrance brand with a Ridgeway store, loyal customers and a clear identity. Explore lessons on consistency, brand clarity and strategic expansion for entrepreneurs building product driven businesses.

item.title: 10 Festive Season Side Hustles to Try
item.description: 10 Festive Season Side Hustles to Try. As the festive season approaches, young South African entrepreneurs are seeking ways to generate extra income while meeting seasonal demand. The holidays bring increased spending, travel, and social gatherings, creating opportunities for agile entrepreneurs. Here are ten festive season side hustles to consider.

item.title: Santam Expands into the UK with Approval for New Lloyd’s Syndicate
item.description: Santam Expands into the UK with Approval for New Lloyd’s Syndicate. Santam has received final approval to launch its new UK-based Lloyd’s syndicate, marking a significant expansion milestone for South Africa’s largest short-term insurer. The new entity, Santam Syndicate 1918, will officially begin underwriting at Lloyd’s on 1 January 2026.

item.title: Siba Mtongana Opens Siba Deli Foodshop and Eatery in Cape Town
item.description: Siba Mtongana Opens Siba Deli Foodshop and Eatery in Cape Town. Siba Mtongana, the international multi award winning culinary expert, author, entrepreneur, and host of the Food Network show Siba’s Table, has officially announced the opening of the Siba Deli Foodshop and Eatery in Cape Town. The new space, located at 7 Park Road in the Longkloof Precinct in Gardens, marks a milestone she describes as more than eight years in the making.

item.title: Crafting a New Beginning: How Kuhle Nongwe Built a Growing Furniture Brand
item.description: Explore how 22 year old self taught carpenter Kuhle Nongwe built Guga Cabinets after facing major setbacks, and discover practical lessons for South African entrepreneurs.

item.title: Brewing Identity: The Rise of Mamelodi Lager
item.description: Discover how entrepreneur Melusi Hlempu built Mamelodi Lager into a growing township rooted beer brand, and explore practical lessons for South African entrepreneurs.

item.title: Sipful Brewery and the Steady Craft of Building a Beverage Brand
item.description: Sipful Brewery founder Patrick Zulu shows how steady growth, strategic product expansion and smart marketing shaped one of Durban’s rising beverage brands. Learn practical lessons South African entrepreneurs can apply today.

item.title: How Princess Kaytumy’s Bakes Turned Consistency Into a Growing Baking Business
item.description: Discover how Princess Kaytumy’s Bakes founder Nare Moloto built a trusted Limpopo bakery through consistency, quality and smart local partnerships. Lessons and insights for South African entrepreneurs.
